tweets.text:
Sadly, I wasn't able to attend Sui Basecamp this year, but I managed to watch the livestream.

Here's a TL;DR of the biggest announcements ↓

1. Google Cloud + Sui

Mysten Labs and @googlecloud are building VAA, which lets companies verify what an AI agent did without exposing the private data underneath. Agents can act, and businesses still get a record they can audit later.

2. Alibaba Cloud + Sui Agent Payments

Agents will be able to use @alibaba_cloud services and pay for them automatically through Sui Agent Payments. No manual approvals needed.

3. New record TPS

Sui hit ~41M TPS in a live Basecamp test. A controlled test isn't the same as normal mainnet activity, but it shows how far they're pushing execution.

4. Sui Threat Intelligence

A new security system that detects suspicious activity, scores transactions, and helps contain threats in real time.

The first two are about giving agents more autonomy. The other two strengthen the infrastructure those agents will depend on.

Disclosure: I'm a $SUI holder.
tweets.quoted_tweet_text:
A world record.

40,614,180 transactions per second. Live at Sui Basecamp, independently analyzed by @CertiK.

AI agents paid, played, and chatted in programmable tunnels. Executed offchain, settled on Sui.

Sui is ready for the agentic economy.

https://t.co/KcWmlNpgaq

Since we first started measuring economies, GDP has only ever been able to grow three ways. Population growth, plus productivity growth, plus debt growth.

That equation is The Everything Code.

And it's what has left us in the mess we're in today. We have too few workers and too much debt. When productivity cant fill the gap, the only lever left is more debt... and the only way to carry that much debt is to debase the currency. That is why everything feels more expensive every year and why your savings never seem to keep up. 

Except now, for the first time in history, we have a way out.

AI and robots change the equation itself. They add workers that dont age, dont retire, get cheaper every year, and add productivity on a scale we've never seen. 

The catch is that it's now moving faster than society, politics or economics can adapt. Coherence breaks down. That is The Economic Singularity.

This is what my book, The Everything Code, charts. It starts with the framework itself, how debt and demographics got us here, moves through The Exponential Age and ends at The Economic Singularity. Everything Ive been working on for years, in one place and in order, so you can see why we have such a short window to position ourselves before the whole system changes completely.

It's out on November 3rd.

If you're planning to read it, I would be really grateful if you would consider pre-ordering. Pre-orders are what move the rankings, and it would mean a great deal to me.

Thanks!

Everyone makes mistakes. 

The main difference is that successful people learn from them and unsuccessful people don’t. 

By creating an environment in which it is okay to safely make mistakes so that people can learn from them, you’ll see rapid progress and fewer significant mistakes. This is especially true in organizations where creativity and independent thinking are important, as success will inevitably require the acceptance of failure as a part of the process. 

As Thomas Edison once said, “I have not failed. I’ve just found ten thousand ways that do not work.” #principleoftheday
